# CANDIDATE: STRUCTURE_VETO_ENABLED

**Filed:** 2026-06-28
**Filer:** chef-nemotron (free-tier autonomous R&D)
**Type:** new_veto_primitive
**Status:** DRAFT (NEEDS-RATIFICATION per Rule 9)

## Hypothesis

We hypothesize that incorporating a structure-based veto into the entry path will improve the overall performance of the engine by removing wrong-way trades. This veto will block P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades, while allowing range or unknown conditions to pass through without a veto.

## Mechanism

The mechanism for this veto involves integrating the `crypto.lib.market_structure.classify_trend` function into the entry path. This function will classify the trend as either uptrend, downtrend, or range/unknown. Based on this classification, the veto will block P-in-uptrend and C-in-downtrend trades.
